relevance_note: Case series of 10 cardiomyopathy patients with post-COVID myocarditis including one woman with Danon disease and her deceased son, both described individually: "a diagnosis of Danon’s disease was confirmed: the same pathogenic mutation in a heterozygous state was detected in the LAMP2 gene as in her son".
method_note: Rows built by hand from reading the paper, written out by a short Python script that also checked spans. Scope: only Patient K (44-year-old woman, Danon disease) and her first son (LAMP2 mutation, HCM and WPW, died at 16) are in scope; the other 9 cohort patients have other cardiomyopathies (cohort size 10). Her father (died suddenly at 60) and second son (15, 'healthy') are not described as tested or affected with Danon disease and get no rows. Label: the paper uses 'Patient K' for two different people (the 44-year-old woman and a 39-year-old man with MYH7/MyBPC3 VUS); only the woman is in scope, so her label is 'Patient K' without a family suffix. Table 1 has patients as columns with no label row (header row is 'Sex'); column 2 (f, 44, 'Danone', LAMP2) is identified as Patient K because it is the only Danon/LAMP2 column; spans quote that row through column 2. The Table 1 genetic-findings cell for column 2 is broken across lines by the conversion ('LAMP2 p.E298' / blank line / 'Afs*38'); the protein value is recorded verbatim with its line breaks rather than joined. Patient K's genomic coordinates come from the son's printed variant (chrX:119576459_119576489del) via the sentence that she carries 'the same pathogenic mutation'; the son's protein change is left null because it is printed only in Patient K's column. Son's inheritance recorded as inherited maternal because the mother (Patient K) is stated to carry the same mutation. No genome build is attached to the coordinates (the GRCh37 statement in Methods concerns WES, not clearly this test). Patient K's vital status 'alive' rests on the Outcomes statement that the only two deaths were in AL-amyloidosis patients, plus Table 1 death row '–' (the '–' symbol is defined only for the SARS-CoV-2 rows, so it is not used alone). LGE is inferred from the group statement 'all patients showed subepicardial LGE'; note an internal contradiction: Methods say MRI of the heart in 6 patients while Results and the abstract say all patients underwent cardiac MRI. Reduced EF checklist item set observed from EF 34–41% on admission (EF 45% in June 2021) though the paper does not use the word 'reduced' for her. ECG 'no evidence of LV hypertrophy' while EchoCG shows LV hypertrophy up to 12 mm: different modalities, recorded as separate rows, not treated as a contradiction; LVH checklist observed from echo. No accessory pathway at the 2018 EP study is recorded as excluded, but the composite pre-excitation checklist item is left not reported for Patient K. 'Coronary angiography did not reveal any abnormal findings' recorded as written (excludes nothing more specific). Son's LVH checklist item set observed from the diagnosis of HCM. No stacked (' / ') cells occur; Table 1 'initial/ follow-up' EF values are defined by the row heading.
